## Summary

Goal: cap concurrent `xcodebuild` in the Weyv build path at 2 slots, run builds
under `nice`, and leave signing untouched.

Delivered, uncommitted, in this worktree under `staging/weyv-xcodebuild-cap/`:

- `xcodebuild-slot.sh`: runs one `xcodebuild` under a 2-slot semaphore.
  - Slots are `lockf(1)` locks (`/usr/bin/lockf -k -t 0`), one file per slot.
    The kernel drops a lock when its holder exits, so a crashed build cannot
    leave a stale slot. A marker file written from inside the lock tells a
    busy slot (lockf exit 75, no marker) apart from a build that exited 75.
  - The build runs as `/usr/bin/nice -n $WEYV_BUILD_NICE` (default 10).
  - Runs in the foreground, so TERM/INT reach the build through the process
    group, and launchd can stop it normally.
  - Waits up to `WEYV_XCODEBUILD_WAIT_SECS` (default 3600) for a slot, then
    exits 75 (EX_TEMPFAIL). Bad configuration exits 2 before any build starts.
  - Environment: `WEYV_XCODEBUILD_SLOTS` (2), `WEYV_XCODEBUILD_SLOT_DIR`
    (`$TMPDIR/weyv-xcodebuild-slots`), `WEYV_XCODEBUILD_WAIT_SECS`,

- `lockf` over a `mkdir` semaphore. A `mkdir` lock needs stale-lock reclaim,

  capability values, provider tokens, and their echoes across the entire
